summary: Share physical file-watch subscriptions across logical input dependencies

schema.detail: Subscriptions and their logical leases remain host-local.

rules.detail: One backend shares parent directories, reference-counts logical users and collapses descendants under recursive roots. Subscription transitions invalidate earlier captures.

compatibility.detail: File gates retain logical-path filtering and replacement recovery. Reads do not wake reconciliation.

recovery.detail: Device and inode identify directories; ordinary child activity preserves identity. Failed post-install checks release backend watches. Directory-loss events and backend errors invalidate coverage for reinstallation. The final logical lease releases subscriptions and the backend.
